subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: When a rung fails, the harness shall return machine-parseable findings — each carrying check id, location (file:line where the check class has one), and a one-line message — with full tool output attached by reference, never as the primary payload.
rationale: compact feedback is the loop's fuel; log dumps burn the agent's context
fit_criterion: 100% of fixture-produced findings validate against the finding schema and carry check id + message; lint/build/test findings carry file:line; no finding payload embeds more than the schema's bounded excerpt
